---
title: "Wadi E Ishq Se Rehmat Ki Sanad Chaahte Hain Hasnain Abidi"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Manqabat"
poet: "Hassaan"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

Ahl-e-Maka Bhi Madine Mein Lehad Chahtey Hain.

1
Noor-e-Wahid Hain Nabi Our Ali So Hum Loag.
Ya Ali Keh Keh Muhammad Se Madad Chahtey Hain.
LaIlaha Ko Issi Tasdeeq Se Hai Illallah.
Tees Parey Issi Lehjay Se Rasad Chahtey Hain.
Muntahib Yani Keh Jis Hath Ko Kar Dein Woh Boland.
Mustarid Yani Woh Jis Baat Ka Rad Chahtey Hain.

2
Aasmano Pe Abhi Our Thehar Taig-e-Ali.
Teri Tanzeel Nabi Rooz-e-Ohad Chahtey Hain.
Qaba Qausain Bhi Kya Bait-e-Abu Talib Hai.
Koi Ijlaas Jahan Ahl-e-Khird Chahtey Hain.
Loag Hassaan Ke Gun Gatay Hain Gaein Akbar.
Naat Par Hum Abu Talib Ki Sand Chahtey Hain.

p = 'src/data/lyrics/wadi-e-ishq-se-rehmat-ki-sanad-chaahte-hain-hasnain-abidi-tajpoints-43682ca8920b8106da7d.md'
old = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'HEAD:{p}'], text=True).split('---\\n', 2)[2].strip()
_, metadata, body = Path(p).read_text().split('---\\n', 2)
roman = '\\n'.join(line[2:] for line in metadata.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1].splitlines()).strip()
assert [l.lower().rstrip('.') for l in old.splitlines()] == roman.lower().splitlines()
assert [len(b.splitlines()) for b in roman.split('\\n\\n')] == [len(b.splitlines()) for b in body.strip().split('\\n\\n')] == [1,7,7]
assert '\\u200c' not in body and 'noUrdu' not in metadata
print('Roman wording preserved; preamble and both six-verse stanzas align.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed the Urdu body and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`, adjusting capitalization and removing verse-end periods. Verified that the opening verse and both six-verse stanzas align. Added the Urdu title, kept the Roman title as `alternateTitle`, set right-to-left direction, and removed `noUrdu`.

I read “Muntahib” as **منتخب** based on its pairing with **مسترد**, and rendered “Qaba Qausain” as **قابَ قوسین**.
